project-knowledge:documentation-engineer.instructions: Does the requested review assess existing technical documentation against implementation for factual drift, missing coverage, stale examples, broken links, duplicated topics, or affected consumers?

criteria.false: The task does not assess existing technical documentation against implementation; authoring alone, voice editing, instruction-policy audits, and code-only review do not qualify.
criteria.true: The task assesses existing technical documentation against implementation across interfaces, configuration, architecture, operations, migrations, or other technical dimensions, whether discrepancies exist or not.
